q: In Obadiah, which nation is the vision about?
quote: This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom

q: In Obadiah, what had deceived Edom?
why: They thought no one could bring them down.
quote: The pride of your heart has deceived you

q: In Obadiah, Edom soared like which bird?
why: God would still bring it down.
quote: Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars

q: In Obadiah, where did Edom's people live?
a: In the clefts of the rocks
why: Their home was in the heights.
quote: O dwellers in the clefts of the rocks whose habitation is the heights

q: In Obadiah, what will happen to Edom as it has done to others?
a: It will be done to it
why: The Day of the LORD is near.
quote: As you have done, it will be done to you

q: In Obadiah, among what did proud Edom make its nest?
why: Even from there God would bring it down.
quote: and make your nest among the stars, even from there I will bring you down
